benchmark_overlay.question_replace: An RO plant reports an RO feed/high-pressure-pump discharge pressure of 78 bar. Classify the state as normal, warning, or immediate shutdown according to the applicable site operating policy, and state the immediate action.

rag_evidence.source_locator: Sheet1, RO feed/high-pressure-pump discharge pressure row
rag_evidence.missing_knowledge: site normal, warning, and immediate-shutdown pressure thresholds
rag_evidence.decision_impact: classifies 78 bar and determines the immediate action

benchmark_overlay.question_replace: An RO plant reports an RO feed/high-pressure-pump discharge pressure of 78 bar. Classify the state as normal, warning, or immediate shutdown according to the applicable site operating policy, and state the immediate action. The applicable policy defines 55-70 bar as normal, above 75 bar as warning, and 80 bar as HH/immediate shutdown.

After normalization to reference conditions, permeate flow has declined by 12%, salt passage is unchanged, and normalized stage pressure drop has increased by 4%. Decide whether membrane cleaning is required under the manufacturer's operating criteria.

rag_evidence.missing_knowledge: manufacturer cleaning thresholds and the one-or-more trigger rule
rag_evidence.decision_impact: determines whether the observed normalized changes require cleaning

benchmark_overlay.question_replace: After normalization to reference conditions, permeate flow has declined by 12%, salt passage is unchanged, and normalized stage pressure drop has increased by 4%. Decide whether membrane cleaning is required under the manufacturer's operating criteria. Cleaning is required when one or more of these occurs: normalized permeate flow drops 10%, normalized salt passage rises 5-10%, or normalized pressure drop rises 10-15%.

An RO plant is proposed to operate at 48% system recovery. Classify this point as normal, warning, or critical under the applicable site operating policy, and state whether unchanged operation is acceptable.

rag_evidence.missing_knowledge: site recommended, warning, and critical recovery bands
rag_evidence.decision_impact: classifies 48% recovery and determines whether unchanged operation is acceptable

benchmark_overlay.question_replace: An RO plant is proposed to operate at 48% system recovery. Classify this point as normal, warning, or critical under the applicable site operating policy, and state whether unchanged operation is acceptable. The applicable policy defines 40-45% as recommended, 45-50% as warning, and above 50% as critical and generally requiring special design or pretreatment.
